DD/MM/YY

The Admissions Officer
Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre
305 Grattan St
Melbourne. VIC. 3000
Dear Sir/Madam,
Re: Mr Bruce Brew. DOB: 2 October 1981
Thank you for taking over the care of Mr Brew, who requires urgent evaluation and management of his Stage 3 oesophageal cancer. Please regard this transfer as one-way and for immediate treatment.
Mr Brew, 31 years old, was admitted on 6 July 2017, suffering an intense gnawing pain below his sternum. He reported difficulty swallowing for the past 4-5 months and had been suffering heartburn since the age of around 30 years, which he has so far self-treated using over-the-counter medications. He also reported a weight loss of 10kg in the past 6 months and weakness in daily routine activities, as he is a local farmer.  As well as this, Mr Brew is a moderately heavy drinker, consuming approximately 20 cans of beer each week.
During hospitalisation, tests including endoscopy, biopsy and barium swallow tests indicated a Stage 3 oesophageal cancer needing urgent specialist treatment for which our hospital is not equipped. The results of these are attached. Epigastric tenderness on palpation was also observed. We have also attached to this letter records of Mr Brew’s observed vital signs.
His current medication is Oxycodone 1 mg/ml in 0.9% saline, 5% dextrose/water, administered intravenously as required.
He is being transferred by Seymour Ambulance Service. Tel: 1300606060.
Please do not hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
Yours sincerely,
Nurse
